title: Data Loss Trauma
problem_statement: Photos are gone — deleted, lost, disappeared — breaking the memory anchor
definition: Photos are missing, deleted, or inaccessible. The user's external memory anchor is broken.
cognitive_note: High emotional valence. The loss of the digital artifact breaks the memory retrieval process entirely.

title: Temporal Amnesia
problem_statement: Users remember roughly when something happened but can't recall the exact date/year
definition: Users know the photo exists from a rough time period (e.g., 'around 2019' or 'winter') but can't narrow down the exact date to find it.
cognitive_note: Episodic vs. Semantic memory mismatch. Time is anchored to events, not calendar dates.

title: Sensory / Visual Cue Search
problem_statement: Users remember what something looked like (color, object, light) but can't describe it in text
definition: Users remember exactly what a scene looked like (a color, lighting, or specific object) but struggle to translate that into a text query.
cognitive_note: Translating rich visual/sensory recall into lexical search terms causes cognitive friction.

title: Event & Context Association
problem_statement: Users remember the occasion but not the date or name
definition: Users remember the context of the photo (a wedding, a vacation) but not the specific date, location name, or people tagged.
cognitive_note: Human memory is heavily event-anchored. Users search by narrative context, not metadata.

title: Facial & Identity Recall Failure
problem_statement: Face recognition breaks as people age or changes lighting
definition: Users want to find all photos of a specific person, but the system fails to connect faces across different ages or lighting conditions.
cognitive_note: Failure of AI facial recognition to map to human object permanence concepts.

title: Lexical / Search Vocabulary Gap
problem_statement: Right memory, wrong words; users can't find the right search vocabulary
definition: The user remembers the photo but can't think of the right word that Google Photos uses to index it.
cognitive_note: Vocabulary mismatch between human conversational memory and systemic tagging ontologies.

title: Pet & Object Identity Confusion
problem_statement: Users can't distinguish between similar-looking animals or objects; AI fails
definition: Users cannot easily search for specific non-human subjects because the system lumps similar-looking animals or objects together.
cognitive_note: Systemic inability to distinguish subtle identity markers in non-human subjects.
